paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 5.75 as of 2026-08-20, representing a decrease of 0.26% from the prior close and 6.13% over the last 24 sessions. There has been one new news item in the last 24 hours.

Fermi Inc. has been mentioned in recent news, with a headline from Stocktwits stating that cofounder Toby Neugebauer believes the market wants cooperation between him and the company's board, as the stock surged to over a 3-month high.

There have been various SEC filings from Fermi Inc., including a Form 4 filing on 2026-08-18, a Form 10-Q filing on 2026-08-14, and two 8-K filings on 2026-08-13, one of which announced the appointment of Lee McIntire as the new Chief Executive Officer.
